deploy-bot: 1788123456 Release deployed to prod :rocket: service=inference-api image=redwood/inference:2.3.9-rc4 clusters=[us-west-2-prod-a] rollout=50% canary started. auto-smoke enabled. https://ci.internal/release/2.3.9-rc4
alex: 1788123460 seeing synthetic KV probe noise on /v1/embeddings - 5m spike in failures and 95th latency jumps to ~1.6s. not huge but flapping.
jamal: 1788123472 confirmed. KV-probe failure count +12 in last 5m, error mix of timeouts and occasional 504 from shard-7. digging logs now.
jamal: 1788123475 logs snippet:
```
2026-03-20T14:47:01Z kv-probe[pid=223]: route=/v1/embeddings fanout=8 timeout=20s -> error: shard-7 timeout after 20s
2026-03-20T14:47:03Z kv-probe[pid=223]: transient 504 from shard-7 HTTP/1.1 504 Gateway Time-out
```
mara: 1788123483 can we pin embeddings route to 2.3.8 for the affected canary cohort? that's what we did last week to avoid user-facing regression. low-risk and quick.
lucy: 1788123490 quick config note: current synthetic probe config is fanout=8 timeout=20s cadence=30s. lowering fanout reduces parallel pressure but increases tail latency sensitivity.
lucy: 1788123493 probe config (current):
```json
{"route":"/v1/embeddings","fanout":8,"timeout_s":20,"interval_s":30}
```
jamal: 1788123505 proposal: reduce fanout -> 4 and increase timeout -> 40s for synth probe; concurrently pin embeddings route traffic for the canary cohort to image=2.3.8 for 2 hours. that should stabilize probe noise and avoid full rollback.
alex: 1788123512 whats impact to SLO and costs?
mara: 1788123518 slight probe cost bump, SLO impact tolerable if we avoid cascading retries. agree with jamal's approach.
alex: 1788123524 i'll prepare the pin and config change. pushing to config-store now. patch: cfg/kv-probes#342 -> fanout=4 timeout_s=40 and route-pin /v1/embeddings -> redwood/inference:2.3.8 for cohort=canary-50
alex: 1788123529 command i used:
```bash
./infractl config apply --path cfg/kv-probes#342 --env prod --yes
./infractl rollout pin-route --route /v1/embeddings --image redwood/inference:2.3.8 --cohort canary-50
```
deploy-bot: 1788123535 Canary paused at 50% :warning: healthcheck threshold breached for /v1/embeddings. auto-rollback disabled due to pinned cohort. Actions: config patch applied, route pin requested.
jamal: 1788123542 i've reduced fanout and increased timeout on the synth probe; replaying 5m synthetic run now. watching shards 6-9 closely.
sre-alerts: 1788123548 synthetic-probe-monitor: degraded -> recovering. 5m failure rate dropping from 6.2% -> 1.1%. see https://monitoring.internal/dashboards/synth-kv
jamal: 1788123553 looks stable on shard-7 now, 95p latency down to 0.9s. leaving pin for the canary cohort for 2 hours as planned. if we see >3% failures again we escalate to rollback.
alex: 1788123557 PR opened: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/987 - includes config change + release note entry. tagging @platform-ops for awareness.
alex: 1788123560 leaving this thread open for the 2h watch window, but marking as mitigated for now :white_check_mark:. if anything regresses we'll revert pin and trigger full rollback.
